title: Cold heater — cold soak at -10 degC ambient with the three-stage heater running

test.description: T4 cold heater — cold soak at -10 degC with the three-stage heater running

defects.mechanism: state-2 entry threshold two kelvin below the minimum temperature, so the pack sits below T_batt_min on the 500 W stage

evaluates.limit: BTMS_P_Heater is 0 / P_heater_middle (500 W) / P_heater_max (2000 W) +-1 W per BTMS_Heater_State, and each of the three states is occupied for at least 1 s
BTMS_Heater_State == 2 at every sample where BMS_T_Batt < T_batt_min (5 degC)
